node_binary.note: unchanged; the compatibility shim does not rebuild Node

unnamed_posix_semaphore.implementation: process-local mutex+condition-variable table keyed by the caller's sem_t pointer; named semaphores fall through to libSystem

system_v_shared_memory.previous: shmget terminated the caller with SIGSYS
system_v_shared_memory.now: shmget returns a positive id; shmat maps; parent writes 0x12345678, a separate child process reads it, writes 0x23456789, parent reads the update; shmdt and shmctl(IPC_RMID) return 0
system_v_shared_memory.implementation: POSIX shm_open + mmap(MAP_SHARED); IPC_PRIVATE ids map to deterministic /n26sv-<id> names so another process can attach by id

execve_stdout_limitation.functional: PASS: same pid before/after execve, JIT/wasm engine state preserved, exit code 0, files written
execve_stdout_limitation.capture: 0 bytes captured on the inherited stdout pipe; also 0 when the probe execve's /var/jb/bin/sh and when using fs.writeSync(1, ...)
execve_stdout_limitation.cause: not isolated to a single mechanism; treated as a test-harness/terminal-inheritance boundary, not a capability failure

attribution: node-2026-11-03-213932/213933/214709.ips: deliberate pre-compat baseline shmget SIGSYS probes, not the compat matrix

limits: Unnamed semaphores are process-local; pshared 0/1 accepted but not shared across processes.
System V shared memory is emulated on POSIX shm; no System V semaphores or message queues.
The compat dylib is injected by the node launcher (and the OpenCode launcher); raw /var/jb/usr/lib/node26/node callers must set DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES themselves.
Coverage is limited to this device/runtime/permissions and the listed operations; --single-threaded remains required.
